paragraphs.text: Rodríguez Ballón International Airport (AQP/SPQU) serves as a key air gateway for Arequipa, PE, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 10/28: 2980 m (9777 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Rodríguez Ballón International Airport with central Arequipa include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from AQP should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Rodríguez Ballón International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Rodríguez Ballón International Airport is AQP and the ICAO code is SPQU.

faqs.q: Which city does AQP airport serve?
faqs.a: Rodríguez Ballón International Airport (AQP) serves Arequipa, PE.
